From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: (none)

Subject: Fwd: EnterpriseCorp procurement flags — request for internal approval (discount + SLA)

Aditya / Laura —

Forwarding EnterpriseCorp's note. They are asking for two potential deviations: 20% discount off list, and SLA adjustment to 99.5% for the first 12 months. Deal: ENT-2026-042 (PO expected mid-May).

Why I think this is worth approving: 
- Strategic customer with potential $1.2M ARR in year 1 (forecasted).
- We meet their security reqs; research team validated model behavior for their workload.

Ask: 
- Aditya: can you confirm margin impact tolerance and whether 20% is within allowed sales exceptions? If not, what counter-offer should I propose (e.g., 15% + onboarding credits)?
- Laura: can procurement/legal accept 99.5% SLA for the initial 12 months? If procurement needs a formal exception form, I attached our SOW draft — happy to complete any forms.

I've attached the SOW draft and our discovery notes. If you prefer, we can do a quick 15-min sync. Need a decision today to meet their procurement window.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: (none)
Date: 2026-04-21T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EnterpriseCorp procurement flags — request for internal approval (discount + SLA)

Marissa —

I reviewed the numbers. Approve up to 18% discount for a strategic name like EnterpriseCorp, provided we include a 12-month minimum commitment and usage thresholds to protect unit economics. 20% is borderline but acceptable if we get a signed 12-month commitment & prepay 50% (or equivalent MRR commitment).

SLA: prefer to hold at 99.9% but can accept a temporary 99.5% for the first 3 months while they validate integration — not 12 months. After 3 months, SLA reverts to 99.9% or we negotiate credits tied to uptime.

Notes: include a finance approval step if they request prepay discounts. I'll escalate to Finance if they push 20% without prepay.

-Aditya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EnterpriseCorp procurement flags — request for internal approval (discount + SLA)

Marissa / Aditya —

Procurement side — provisional approval with conditions: 
1) Discount: approve up to 18% with a mandatory 12-month term and standard onboarding credits (as Aditya suggested). Finance must confirm the final pricing schedule.
2) SLA: we can accept 99.5% for an initial 90-day validation period with an automatic revert clause to 99.9% thereafter OR credits escalation tied to downtime. Legal to draft the exception language.

Please complete the attached procurement-exception-form.pdf and include: deal value forecast, justification (strategic name + referenceable workload), and the proposed fallback SLA language. I'll route to Procurement and Legal for formal signoff. Also flagging Security — they want confirmation on data retention and logs (they asked for audit-log retention for 12 months). Please coordinate if EnterpriseCorp stores regulated PII.

Laura
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement-exception-form.pdf
